periods.analysis: We made 112 outreach contacts in Q1, held back by February ice storms that cancelled two weeks of visits.
periods.recommendations: Add a second outreach worker for spring.

periods.analysis: Contacts rose from 112 to 164 after a second outreach worker started in April.
periods.recommendations: Recruit friendly-caller volunteers to keep in touch between visits.

periods.analysis: Contacts rose from 164 in Q2 to 231 in Q3, driven by door-to-door visits at Old Ferry Road senior housing and shift-worker outreach at the seaport.
periods.recommendations: Record how many contacts result in a referral or enrollment, so the measure reflects follow-through.
